The security performance of the base-level power network is directly related to the stable operation of the entire power grid, so it is necessary and important to study the active defense technology.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Approach for Leaf Disease of Sugarcane Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The primary crop used to produce sugar and ethanol in the globe is sugarcane. One issue in the sugar sector is if sugarcane illnesses are not treated and diagnosed early, they can eradicate growing crops that are infected with the disease, costing small-scale farmers money. The continuously growing categories of illnesses and farmers’ limited capacity for disease diagnosis and identification served as the impetus for this investigation. Deep learning techniques combined with computer vision and machine learning provide a solution to this problem. In this work, a deep learning model with a 97% accuracy rate was constructed and evaluated using 1200 photos of healthy and sick sugarcane leaves. By distinguishing between classes of healthy and ailing or diseased sugarcane leaves in photographs of sugarcane, the trained model successfully performed its objective. This study recommends employing a deep learning system to help farmers recognize and classify sugarcane illnesses.

Author Keywords: and the detection of sugarcane leaf disease

articleTitle: Economic Forecast Model and Development Path Analysis Based on BP and RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In recent years, the economy of Guangdong province has ranked first in China for many consecutive years, with a strong growth momentum. In the future, whether Guangdong’s GDP can maintain high-quality growth is an important issue. Neural network is an important tool for prediction. The neural network is mainly divided into BP neural network and RBF neural network. Combining the economic forecasting theory and the characteristics of BP neural network algorithm and RBF neural network, this paper studies the economic growth prediction of Guangdong province based on the artificial neural network algorithm and RBF neural network algorithm. The results of empirical research show that the artificial neural network has good prediction accuracy, but the data of economic growth prediction by various neural networks are different, and some errors are very large. Compared with BP neural network, RBF neural network model is one of good economic prediction models with high accuracy and less time.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Non-overlapping Two Phase Clock Signal Generators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this paper, the performance of three non- overlapping clock signal generators are analyzed and compared with each other. The first type of clock generator is based on combinational gates propagation delay and inversion of the signal. The second one is derived from master slave JK flip-flop along with NAND gates. The final type is extracted from a SR latch realized using NOR gates and inverters to induce delay. All the three clock generators are designed in 180 nm CMOS technology and simulated using SPICE tool. The various performance parameters such as under-lap, power consumption, driving capability and number of transistors are measured for all the types and tabulated for comparison. The performance analysis helps one to select the suitable topology for the given application.

articleTitle: Proposal for a Local Database: Segmentation and Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The management of fisheries in Senegal presents many difficulties, at the level of the fishing docks the fish caught are neither declared nor collected for stock recovery and fish classification. To achieve the objectives of detection, segmentation is one of the most important aspects. It is in this context that segmentation has been the subject of several research themes in recent years. In the field of fisheries in Senegal, data collection is very difficult due to the fact that the techniques used are very often manual. Consequently, a local database adapted to the objectives of the survey is lacking. In this paper, we have proposed a semantic segmentation algorithm that tends towards intelligent systems for collecting artisanal fisheries catches. Data are collected by taking images of caught fish and on Fishbase. The collected data applied to the algorithm allowed us to obtain a set of segmented data with the masks of the images which constitutes our local database.

articleTitle: Semicircular-Shaped Dual-Band MIMO Antenna for Wideband Sub-6 GHz Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: A compact semicircular-shaped self-isolated dual-band Multiple-Input-Multiple-Output (MIMO) patch antenna incorporated with defected ground structure (DGS) for wideband application at the sub-6 GHz frequency band is presented in this paper. The return loss, Mutual Coupling, Gain, Radiation Patterns, Envelope Correlation Coefficient (ECC), and Diversity Gain(DG) are studied over the1.3-7.3 GHz frequency band. Over the entire 6GHz bandwidth, the first resonant frequency appears at 2. 691GHz, with a return loss of -23.61dB, and the second resonant frequency at 4.429 GHz, with a -32.86dB return loss, is measured. In addition, -45dB port isolation is achieved at a higher resonating frequency, and a peak gain of 20 dB is observed at 4.1 GHz. This dualband MIMO antenna shows significant results for wideband at sub-6 GHz wireless applications.

articleTitle: Design of French Visual-audio-oral Platform Based on Streaming Media Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Streaming is a major breakthrough in the field of modern education technology by providing a more vivid and comprehensive presentation of teaching content. French visualaudio-oral platform based on streaming media technology uses a layered architecture consisting of a’User layer, Service layer, Application layer, and Data layer’, with each layer implemented through an interface to facilitate collaborative development between team members and improve the efficiency and quality of development. To improve compression performance, H.266/VVC encoding is used, following the hybrid encoding framework of H.265/HEVC and introducing a variety of advanced encoding techniques with higher compression capabilities than the H.265/HEVC standard. The Nginx-based streaming server is still fast when accessed under heavy traffic conditions, and the latency of web pages and application execution is within manageable limits.

articleTitle: Implementation of Teaching Effect Evaluation Platform based on Fuzzy Synthesis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Based on the actual demand of teachers’ mixed teaching effect evaluation, this paper designs a comprehensive evaluation system for teachers’ teaching effect on the basis of summarizing the sources of evaluation data and analyzing the different roles of students, teachers and teaching administrators. Based on the requirements of the system, the functional model, structural model and behavior model of the system are constructed. The detailed design of data management and evaluation process is completed by using UML, and the system database is formed. The multi-layer system architecture of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and the Net framework function module technology are used to demonstrate the effect of the system function realization. Through the teaching of international Chinese course, the system function and performance test of the teaching effect of Chinese cultural image communication is carried out, which verifies the stability and reliability of the system operation and realizes the expected function.

articleTitle: Automatic Lighting Design of Building Information Model Based on K-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Architecture is the place where people live, work and study. Modern building structures are becoming more and more complex, and there are many unfavorable factors, such as energy saving, water saving and landscape lighting, which need to be studied in architectural design and lighting. This paper takes building lighting as the background, combines intelligent network, wireless communication, image processing and other technologies, applies parametric control of lighting system (i.e. intelligent control) to digital map, and constructs a digital model containing building feature information and historical information of lighting system. The model can monitor the running state of the lighting system and adjust the light power and brightness in real time. In the process of actual lighting system transformation, in order to make it more intelligent and convenient for automation, this paper adopts the automatic lighting design method based on building information model (BIM). Automatic lighting and automatic fault detection and alarm functions can be realized through the network, which has better curative effect and better usability compared with the automation level.

articleTitle: Application and Analysis of Virtual Reality Technology in Communication Power Supply Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Communication power supply equipment is a key component in the communication network. Its performance is directly related to the survival of the entire enterprise and the normal operation of the entire country’s communication network. In order to seek a more convenient and effective design, testing and other methods, this paper mainly studies the virtual test technology of communication power supply devices. This paper takes the virtual experiment of the communication power supply device as the research object, establishes a virtual experiment platform, and uses ANSYS software to perform modal analysis of the device. The experimental results show that the finite element method can be used to obtain more accurate mode parameters, which verifies that the design of this system is reasonable. Therefore, the use of virtual reality technology to study communication power supply equipment is particularly important.

articleTitle: A Decision Tree Classification Model for detection Of Tourette Syndrome Using Cognitive and Olfactory Testing Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Tourette’s Syndrome (TS for short) is normal neurodevelopment disorder that becomes active during childhood or adolescence. This is described by multiple motor tics (motor tics) and at least one vocal (vocal) tic. Examples of tics include blinking, coughing, clearing the throat, sniffling, and facial movements. Two aspect of Tic disorder are Motor and vocal which depends on level of the complication. The demographic, cognitive and olfactory testing data can be used to develop a model to predict the Tourette’s syndrome in the population and measures can be taken to treat the identified patients. This research paper attempts to build up a machine learning based model to predict TS based on demographic and cognitive testing and Olfactory testing data sets. Results show that Decision Tree model is able to predict the syndrome with $ 100\%$ accuracy, 1 Mathew’s correlation coefficient, 100parcent F1-score, 100parcent precision and $ 100\%$ recall on the limited available dataset.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of E-Commerce Platform for Characteristic Agricultural Products
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of information technology, the information revolution has swept the world, which has changed the lifestyle of people at home and abroad. Taking the most basic shopping as an example, great changes have been realized from offline to online, from single to multiple. The development of ecommerce platform is the most rapid. Electronic mall is a commodity trading platform built by e-commerce software. The electronic mall based on the Internet and B2C can effectively integrate resources. This paper, through the analysis and research of Jilin Province characteristic agricultural products, carries out the design and development of Jilin Province characteristic agricultural products ecommerce platform, and makes contributions to social construction and self-realization.

articleTitle: Analysis of 6T Full Adder using 2T XOR and 2T XNOR Module
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Power consumption and delay factors are the main design restrictions in the developing nanometer technology Schematics. The major component of an ALU, or Arithmetic logic unit, of a processor is the full adder. Therefore, altering the Full Adder’s parameters in a significant way will directly affect the ALU’s and then the Processor’s parameters. This paper proposes designing a 6T full adder using 2T XOR and 2T XNOR modules using Cadence Virtuoso GPDK 90nm technology. The 2T XOR and 2T XNOR modules will then be replaced with CPTL logic in the 6T full adder. The 2T XOR module using PTL has the lowest PDP of 109.38 and the 2T XOR module using CPTL has the lowest delay of 7. 17Sps. The conclusion drawn from the parametric analysis of output noise, power consumption, and delay obtained from the proposed circuits will then be presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Construction and Implementation of Hierarchical Teaching Model based on Fast Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In view of the individual differences in student groups, the traditional teaching model cannot meet the needs of students’ all-round development. Stratified teaching focuses on individual differences and learning needs of students, and makes targeted teaching plans and objectives, which is conducive to the improvement of the overall teaching effect. By establishing the difference model in stratified teaching and taking the computer network course as an example, the hierarchical teaching model based on the fast-clustering algorithm (K-means) is designed to achieve the hierarchical learning of students. The simulation experiment shows that the hierarchical teaching model based on the fast-clustering algorithm is more scientific and reasonable than the hierarchical method of expert classification algorithm and student total score ranking, and can provide reference for other disciplines.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Double Tailed Cascaded Comparator for EEG Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This brief shows the necessity of power consumption in a dynamic cross-coupled latch-based comparator. The proposed comparator is mainly designed using a cascading method that benefits in lowering power consumption as well as power delay product which is suitable to implement in EEG (Electroencephalogram) applications and in other cardiac IMD (Implantable Medical Devices). The latched comparator as analog to digital converter series a crucial function in terms of the amount of power consumed. This work presents a cascaded comparator circuit which is simulated at the CMOS technology node of 180nm using the Mentor Graphics Tool. The simulation result shows power dissipation 19.126$\mu$W at 0. 8V supply voltage and 19.19$\mu$W at 0. 6V supply voltage which is quite less as compared to the existing comparator circuits. In addition, the power delay product of the proposed comparator is 0. 383pJ when the supply voltage is 0. 8V, and it is 0.0384 when the supply voltage is 0. 6V.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multi feature Face Detection Anti fatigue Driving System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In order to better prevent the problem of driver fatigue driving and protect the safety of people’s lives and property, many automobile manufacturers and scientific research institutions have carried out research on this. Detection methods based on physiological characteristics, such as heart rate detection, detection methods based on vehicle driving information and detection methods based on driver behavior characteristics, came into being as a solution for fatigue driving detection. The first two methods cannot be put into large-scale use under actual production conditions due to their problems of limiting the driver’s body and detecting the low accuracy and accuracy rate, respectively. In response to the above problems,this paper adopts the detection method based on the driver’s behavior characteristics, combined with the depth learning algorithm which is widely used and has significant advantages in the field of computer vision, selects the method of multi feature comprehensive judgment as the innovation point, proposes to use the head posture characteristics as the basis for comprehensive judgment, to judge whether there is the behavior of nodding due to drowsiness, In this way, an efficient and reliable fatigue driving detection scheme is designed and implemented, and focuses on the research of the algorithm based on the state change of the eyes, Using Python and OpenCV function library to simulate related algorithms, the feasibility of the software implementation process is verified. It realizes real-time and accurate monitoring and detection of whether the driver is in a state of fatigue driving. [1]

articleTitle: Fake News Spotting using Interrelated Feature Selection Model using Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This study aids us in evaluating the validity of fake news by employing many classification strategies. Fake news actually has a major effect on our social lives. Specifically, in the fields of politics and teaching. By developing a victimization-based fake news detection model with a separate approach of categorization, a solution to the problems caused by fake news is proposed. When resources, such as fake news detection, are taken into account, things get tricky. “Fake news," or news reports that are erroneous and come from questionable sources, can be easily identified with the use of applications developed using NLP (Natural Language Processing) techniques, which this research aims to do. Using a (Term Frequency Inverse Document Frequency) tfi-df matrix, which tallies words based on how often they appear in other articles in your dataset, is merely a starting point for constructing a model. One form of scarce resource is datasets. Logistic regression, Thomas Bayes’s naïve machine, and the Passive Aggression Classifier were all employed in the classification processes of this model. Our model’s extraction of features for victimisation employs approaches like Term Frequency-Inverse Document (TF-IDF) frequency and logistic regression with an accuracy of 97%.

articleTitle: Analysis of Website in Web Data Mining using Web Log Expert Tool
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Nowadays, web data mining has become an easy and important way to find valuable information. Its main objective is to evaluate and model the logs on the web server and find true patterns. Typically, the web mining process automatically determines the usage behavior of site clients. It uses web usage analysis using information mining techniques to learn informative data hidden in the web server log file. The extracted data from server’s logs is a client access design that involves user behavior patterns. Understanding the user’s frequent access patterns allows the website to further develop user interested things in the web space. In this paper, we use Web log expert tool to analyze the website of institution. It assesses the significant data about visitors, top, error, web browsers and various stages utilized by website users. This tool helps in evaluating the viability of the website in real time.

articleTitle: Sidelobe Suppression of Antenna Array Using Harmony Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this paper, sidelobe suppression problem in the antenna radiation pattern is taken into consideration. Dealing with this optimization problem, an algorithm that is called Harmony Search Algorithm (HSA) is proposed and compared with existing and used algorithms in the literature, Particle Search Algorithm (PSO) and Artificial Bee Colony (ABC). A statistical comparison is carried out to examine the differences in performance. The results show that HSA can be used to suppress sidelobes with considerably short processing time.

articleTitle: Achievement Analysis and Management System Based on Data Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the continuous development of education information demand, the curriculum construction of colleges and universities has produced a large number of management data which need to be processed and sublimated. In order to achieve the goal of improving PE teaching quality based on mining teaching data, the application scheme of decision tree algorithm in PE curriculum analysis and management is designed and implemented. By analyzing the method of data mining –C4.5 decision tree algorithm, combined with the framework of course analysis and management system and the design of database, through the NET development language, SQL Server database, Visual Studio development environment to realize the course management platform based on the teaching process data. The test results show that the proposed PE curriculum management platform can improve the efficiency and quality of PE curriculum management. The software module of decision tree algorithm is realized by using Analysis Service. The running results show that the proposed system can provide valuable scientific basis for the management and analysis of student achievement based on data mining.

articleTitle: Polarization Mismatch in Terms of Rough Surface Using Radar Backscattering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Polarization mismatch is one of the most frequent phenomena in terms of the usage of linear polarimetry in radar applications. It is described by the difference in the phase of the signals of the incident and received radar antenna. In this paper, we study this phenomenon using experimental data obtained for a linearly polarized wave along rough surface by ground-based radar. The paper demonstrates that the signal, scattered on a triangular corner reflector, has a polarization mismatch due to re-reflection from the Earth’s surface. This phenomenon can be described by orthogonal decomposition of the polarized waves as the components of a special unitary group SU2. Using polarization loss factor (PLF), we have shown that the polarization mismatch for a horizontally polarized wave is less than for a vertically polarized wave. In conditions of fluctuation of vegetation, volume scattering dominates over even-bounce scattering. We have demonstrated the vertically polarized wave is highly susceptible to polarization mismatch than a horizontally polarized wave.

articleTitle: Design of News Interview Network Broadcast System Based on Streaming Media Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: News interview network broadcast is a form of communication for the television media. Through modern communication technology, the real situation of the news scene and the reporter’s live interview information are directly launched and instantly synchronised to the general audience. In this paper, based on streaming technology, firstly, the network broadcast system architecture is studied and the capture terminal and the playback terminal are connected through a streaming server. The mobile terminal supports Android and iOS operating systems, and the fixed terminal supports Windows operating systems. Then, the live streaming server architecture is constructed and the related load balancing techniques, content distribution techniques, content storage techniques and content management techniques are studied. Finally, the audio and video synchronisation method are designed to adjust the playback according to the timestamps and reference clocks of the audio and video.

articleTitle: Analysis of Adaptive Equalization Techniques for Burst Digital Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Adaptive equalizer is one of the key building blocks of receiver chain employed in wireless communication systems. It attempts to eliminate the Inter Symbol Interference (ISI) induced due to multipath fading. In this paper, rationale for selection of suitable adaptive equalization scheme, pertinent to burst digital transmission under various channel conditions, has been provided. Various aspects of adaptive equalizer design considering burst mode of operation has been discussed. Besides that, hardware implementation result for various equalization schemes has been presented so as to ascertain their suitability.

articleTitle: Heart Arrhythmia Detection using Deep Learning (LSTM)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Using the resources Deep Learning and Medical has to offer, a model is created which is capable enough to detect the abnormalities in the sinusoidal rhythm of the heart which will be detected using Neural Networking (creating different layers and assigning different variables to them, so to get the desired outcome at a higher accuracy). The use of Neural Network will enable us to circumvent any hinderance in the outcome as medical results might affect the entropy at a personal level. This will predict the outcome after analysing the R sinusoidal wave, which then to complicate the model, then will be supplemented with P, Q and S sinusoidal waves further to enhance the result and in exchange reducing the accuracy a little bit.

articleTitle: A Tourist Online Consumption Data Analysis Platform Based on Real-time Satellite Positioning Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the rapid development of communication technology and computer application, satellite navigation system has become an important part of the city, and its positioning service function is one of the key contents of the national security monitoring agency. This paper builds an online consumption data analysis platform for tourists based on real-time tracking and positioning as the main research object. First, it introduces the relevant concepts and basic knowledge of tourists’ travel path query, and then preprocesses the original data to obtain the user’s current location information, and uses the target axis to provide the destination information and historical trend and other parameters as prediction features to achieve automatic matching. After that, the software simulation test was used to test the function of the platform. The test results showed that the positioning time and payment module of the online consumer travel platform based on real-time positioning technology were maintained at about 5 seconds, and the efficiency of the information communication module and location positioning were both above 90%, which indicated that the platform could meet the needs of users.

articleTitle: Implementation of Dual Band Slot Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This article presents a compact dual-band octagonal shape slotted formation patch antenna for WLAN/WiMAX and X band wireless applications. Proposed design consist the circular slotted radiating section with six octagonal shape and two hexagonal shape elements to produce the resonating bands at 3.12-6.34 GHz (WiMAX: 3.5 GHz, WLAN: 5.8 GHz) and 7.48-14.87 GHz (X band: 8-12 GHz) respectively. Antenna is printed on Forgotten Realms 4 (FR-4) dielectric substrate material. The ground plane and feedline are designed in trapezoidal shape. The antenna is designed with size compactness of 29. 5× 22× 1.6mm<sup>3</sup> and analysed regarding simulated results of return loss, radiation patterns, gain and radiation efficiency. Simulated results are consistent and stable at generated operating bands.

articleTitle: Optimization Design and Implementation of Web Fingerprint Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Since the implementation of the ‘‘Internet plus’’ strategy, a large number of open-source frameworks have been used to build Web sites, that’s bringing convenience as well as security risks. As the key technology of the network security evaluation system, Web fingerprint identification technology can effectively provide whether the target system exists the risk of Web service security vulnerabilities and conduct hidden trouble troubleshooting. Traditional Web fingerprint identification and detection has many problems, such as slow scanning speed, low identification accuracy, limited number of identification fingerprints, the need to construct a large number of abnormal HTTP requests, easy to trigger the firewall, and unable to timely alert the potential vulnerabilities of the website. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a Web fingerprint identification system optimization and development. After a lot of testing and analysis, it can effectively improve the port scanning speed and improve the accuracy of Web fingerprint identification.

articleTitle: An Efficient Brain Tumor Classification using CNN and SVM Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The Brain is the controller of the Human system. The unusual growth and partitioning of brain cells lead to a brain tumor which is a severe disease, it’s further growth leads to Brain Cancer. The complicatedness of brain tissue demands professional technicians and skillful medical doctors to manually assess and analyze brain tumors using multiple Magnetic Resonance (MR) images with various functionalities, which are the most reliable and secure imaging method that detects every minute object. Brain tumor classification assumes a crucial part in clinical examination and viable treatment. Recently, researchers have shown an increased interest in achieving accurate classification utilizing ML, DL, and neural networks. In this methodology, we plan a strategy for brain tumor characterization utilizing an element of profound features and ML classifiers. In our suggested structure, we support the idea of the SVM strategy and utilized many previously learned deep convolutional neural networks to segregate profound elements from brain MRI images. The filtered significant features are then assessed by a bunch of ML classifiers. Three important profound elements which execute well on a few ML classifiers are selected and collectively form a cluster of deep features which are then taken care of into a few ML classifiers to anticipate the outcome. To inspect the different kinds of previously designed models as ML classifiers, deep feature extractors, and the viability of clustering elements for tumor classification. We utilized 3 distinct brain MRI datasets that are directly accessible from the Kaggle. Trial results display that a group of deep features can assist with further developing execution incredibly, and much of the time, a Support Vector Machine competes with various classifiers, particularly for huge datasets.

articleTitle: Design of Free-Focused: Screen-Time Tracker and Task Management Browser Extension
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Since the industrial revolution, the world has been seeking new advancements in technologies. The global movement in the advancement of technology since 2008 brought in the advent of Information Technology and Web development globally. Today, we aim to make everything more and more advanced, convenient, and at our fingertips. Every technology and software today focused on decreasing human effort. The development of the web browser and the Internet has played a vital role in the all-around IT technology development. In this vast system of services, a browser extension plays a small role in managing the browser. A browser extension is like a mini-website with a graphical user interface which allows the user to change the functionalities of a browser. The base idea is to change or modify the browser’s functionality, providing a better user experience. This screen time tracker and task management browser extension enables the user to get the status of their screen time and access a platform that manages all their tasks. It helps boost the productivity of an individual. The main objective of Free Focused is to ease the social and organizational complications that may occur in one’s work life.

articleTitle: Application of Hopfield Neural Network Algorithm in Mathematical Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Neural network model is an important research direction in mathematical modeling, also known as artificial neural net, which is composed of artificial neural network, brain and other systems, and its main research object is pattern recognition, which has a wide range of applications in mathematical modeling. It can simulate the human brain’s information processing process by learning through its structure and function, and has strong self-adaptive ability. It can simulate various patterns that may appear in the human brain’s information processing process, and can make predictions and decisions. The neural network model can be a good solution to the traditional mathematical modeling methods, and also has the characteristics of better fault tolerance and generalization ability, which can easily transform the mathematical problems into computer solutions, and can make the model can be solved in a limited time by processing the data.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Multi-GNSS Observations From Android Smartphones
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Modern smartphones are embedded with Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) sensors and enables them to be used for the collection of raw data for basic GNSS research. Low-cost GNSS chips stimulated innovation in highprecision positioning, navigation, and timing capabilities. The objective of this study is to examine and contrast the GNSS Android observations from different satellite systems (e.g., GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, etc.) obtained from Android smartphones equipped with single-and dual-frequency GNSS chipsets. The observations were collected using commonly available smartphones in a clear sky environment and the data were analyzed in terms of signal strength. The results showed that the dual-frequency multi-GNSS signals provided better signal strength and reliability compared to single-frequency GNSS signals. This analysis will provide valuable insights into the potential of using Android smartphones as low-cost multiGNSS receivers for various applications.

articleTitle: Global Isolating Centrality Measure for Finding Vital Nodes in Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Identification of influential vertices plays a very prominent task in a complex network. So, the fundamental task in complex networks is to determine the influential nodes whose expulsion crucially cutoff network harmony. The analysis of the network’s topological characteristics, such as susceptibility and resilience, can be aided by identifying influential nodes. This work uses the notion of Maximize the Number of Connected Components Problem, which helps in determining influential nodes, and whose removal yields optimum number of connected components. This work includes application of topology-based centrality measures on real-world networks. However, conventional methods fail to detect most influential nodes that cause the network to split into the optimum number of components. To address this, our work introduces new centrality called global isolating centrality with half of the diameter hops, that focus on network connectedness. The results reveal that the new centrality is better than the existing centralities for certain probability values.

articleTitle: Ultra-Low Power and High Speed CNTFETs Based Magnitude Comparator Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Graphene and its derivatives have huge demand in future electronic devices due to its high capability to overcome restrictions that silicon materials must overcome.The Carbon NanoTubes(CNTs), can be obtained by rolling the Graphene sheet into tubes, which are Carbon NanoTubes that have attracted and got huge concern from scientific researchers. Huge efforts have been put on for the development and optimisation of nanoscale Carbon Nanotube Field Effect Transistors because of its promising applications in the field of modern electronics. This device itself has enormous number of advantages and the comparator designed with this CNTFET has much more improved performance. Here I have designed a comparator circuit using only 10 CNTFETs this circuit has power delay product improvement of 73.6% compared to comparator using 12 CNTFETs. These magnitude comparator circuit is simulated in HSpice Platform. Stanford library CNTFET model is used in HSpice to execute this comparator.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of an Adder-Subtractor Using UVM Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: An adder-subtractor is a unique circuit in digital circuits that can perform addition or subtraction. The circuit decides to conduct addition or subtraction depending on the control signal. The Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) is regarded as the standard procedure for evaluating digital circuit designs. UVM is a collection of SystemVerilog classes and other techniques that makes it simple to build sophisticated, reusable verification environments. When verification processes demand randomization, UVM is the most effective. In this paper, we propose a method UVM which provides more automation than earlier methodologies for verification of adder-subtractor circuits using EDA playground.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Large Scale Machine Learning Optimization Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: optimization methods effectively solve challenging machine learning problems. optimization is the numerical computation of the system-designed parameter to make predictions on big data. Machine learning algorithms train the machine to make high-quality predictions. optimization algorithms are used to find the optimal solution for a given objective function. This article provides a review of some of the optimization algorithms. The article also highlights the need for optimization algorithms on large-scale data. We provide a Comparative analysis of the Stochastic and Batch Gradient optimization method. Simulation results verify that both methods can provide an optimal solution. The simulation result also shows that the stochastic gradient method achieves an initial fast convergence, but its performance slows down after some iteration. We also investigate the effect of learning rate on both methods and conclude that both methods with variable learning rates achieve faster convergence than the fixed learning rate. The stochastic gradient method is also computationally more efficient as it computes the gradient on a single sample instead of the whole training data set.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Visual Object Tracking Approaches & Impact on Benchmarks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Visual Tracking is an approach through which a moving object can be tracked at distinct pixel points and coordinates. It is a part of machine vision technology where a machine can recognize the objects as per the patterns and track in the whole frame accordingly. There are so many challenges to recognize the object and track without any overflow. Conventional model is not able to detect the object in the entire frame with high level of accuracy. Machine learning is in trending phase where a dataset can be trained to obtain the better result in tracking the object with more preciseness. There are several researches have been done in this field but certain flaws present in the existing systems for few challenges. Each and every system has its own flaws where accuracy may degrade and system encounters more overlap. There are various benchmarks are available to test the system and obtain the result accordingly to pertain the precision rate. The intention of this paper is to find out the flaws present in the existing algorithms and their results as per the benchmark selected. There are various challenges present in the benchmarks which need to be revised with better accuracy.

articleTitle: Achievability Approximation of IDS Hub Using Collaborative Network Model With ML
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Intrusion detection systems (IDSs) have been generally sent in PCs and organizations to recognize a variety of attacks. Yet, network intrusions are presently turning out to be more modern to distinguish, accordingly collaborative intrusion detection networks (CIDNs) have been proposed which empower an IDS to gather data and take in experience from different IDS hubs. By keeping up with associations among a bunch of IDS hubs, a CIDN is relied upon to be all the more remarkable in recognizing some muddled assaults like denial-of-service (DoS) than a solitary IDS. In genuine organization, we distinguish that every IDS might have various degrees of affectability in recognizing various sorts of interruptions (i.e., because of their marks and settings). In this paper, we along with these lines characterize a thought of interruption affectability and examine the achievability of utilizing it to assess the reliability of an IDS hub. What’s more, we describe a few difficulties when utilizing this idea in practice.

articleTitle: Continuous Twisting Sliding Mode Control for Spacecraft Attitude Maneuver
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This paper devises a strategy to reduce the chattering in second order sliding mode control designed for anti-unwinding attitude stabilization for a rigid spacecraft. To represent the attitude kinematics the unit quaternion is applied. Firstly, an integral type sliding output function is defined and then, a chattering-free attitude control law is developed in second order sliding mode using a continuous twisting type control. The proposed controller aims to ensure finite time convergence to equilibrium and limit the chattering. Numerical simulation is conducted with external disturbances applied to check the proposed control effectiveness. The simulation results confirm the proposed controller efficacy.

articleTitle: Design of Body Function Index Mobile Query System for College Students Based on Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Decision tree is the core technology of data mining. According to different characteristics, classification or decision sets are represented by tree structure, and rules and development rules are generated. The decision tree algorithm takes the information gain as the basis of attribute division and selects the attribute with the maximum information gain as the split node to generate the decision tree. Based on comparison of typical decision tree algorithms, CART algorithm is used in this paper. This paper studies the pruning of decision tree based on the principle of CART algorithm, designs the logical structure of data storage based on SQL Server database management system, and constructs the moving query process of college students’ physical function index. The research results solve the key technical problems of the system development and provide a complete solution for the construction of the mobile inquiry system of the physical function index of college students.

articleTitle: Sentimental Analysis of Arabic Tweets related to COVID-19 using AraBERT model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Coronavirus has affected the lives of almost everyonebelonging from every aspect of life. COVID-19 has caused depressions, anxiety, stress, fear among the people. Every countryaround the world is facing various challenges amid COVID-19 and trying to implement some measure in order to control the spread of COVID-19. Now-a-days, social media is a powerful tool and people use it for sharing their feelings and thoughts. Like people of all other counties and cultures, Arab people also sharedtheir thoughts on social media during COVID-19. However, the Arabic language is rich in morphology and has a large number of dialects. Arabic Sentimental Analysis has attracted many researchers but still the research work on Arabic Language is limited. In this research, we used AraCOV-19 data, an Arabic language dataset related to COVID, and assigned the sentiments labels to each tweets using Textblob-ar, after doing necessary pre-processing. We classify the negative and positive tweets using AraBERT model and compared the results with state-of-the- art models. The results showed that our model outperformedall other state-of-the-art models by achieving 93% and 92% accuracy for positive and negative classification respectively. Hence, such methods of sentimental analysis are very helpful in devising new policies for the control and prevention of epidemics like COVID-19.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of Range Safety Panel for Flight Termination System using LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This paper demonstrates the design and implementation of a field programmable gate array (FPGA) based range safety panel (RSP) for flight termination system(FTS). In flight testing center, FTS is used for transmitting command to the flight vehicle and destroy it if it is out of designated path. Flight safety officer observes the behavior of the flight vehicle and remotely controls the FTS using RSP. NI SbRIO - 9607 compact rio controller along with Xilinx FPGA is used for RSP realisation. LabVIEW programming language is used to implement the system in real time within designated time delay acceptable for decision making process by range safety officer. GUI is designed For configuration and monitoring of RSP Performance in real time in LabVIEW. The real time performance of the system is validated against its expected performance using various test cases in real time local and remote operations.

articleTitle: Integrated Xception- Random Forest Model for the Detection of Rheumatoid Arthritis in Hand Thermograms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) is a persistent inflammatory condition that affects the finger joints, wrist, knee, and foot. It leads to severe disease progression and immobility if not treated in the earlier stage. The study aims to build a hybrid convolutional neural network (CNN) - machine learning (ML) model for classifying RA and healthy participants. The main objectives of the current study are to (i) develop an automated feature extraction method by using modified Xception features (ii) build an integrated model by combining Xception- Random Forest classifier for the prediction of RA disease. The database for the proposed work was created by acquiring thermal hand images of 50 healthy and 50 RA patients. A modified Xception model was employed to extract the features; feature selection was performed using a correlation heat map and classification using a random forest (RF) classifier. The RF classifier obtained an accuracy of 95.83 %, a sensitivity of 91.67 %, and a specificity of 100 %, respectively. Therefore, thermal imaging can be used as a supporting modality that can help the physicians to diagnose RA at the earlier stages.

articleTitle: A Tri-forked Antenna for UWB applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Communication over short distances with high speed is now possible due to ultra wideband (UWB) technology. Planar small printed antennas have shown to be unmatched in terms of performance and simplicity of integration in portable devices, a lot of effort and research has gone into the design of UWB antennas for a variety of applications, including scans, position, and radar systems, as well as wireless connectivity. To encompass the ultra - wide operational bandwidth of the UWB applications, a variety of Ultra - wideband have been designed. The potential uses of Wireless communication technology have been currently becoming more and more obvious. In this paper, a 30mmx30mm x 1.6mm FR-4 substrate-based UWB antenna is presented with truncated ground and tri-forked shaped in the patch. The substrate thickness is 1.6 mm, the dielectric constant is $\varepsilon$r=4.4 and the loss tangent is tan$\delta$=0.02, which achieved bandwidth of 6. 8GHz and having Omni-directional radiation characteristics.

articleTitle: Key Technologies of Constructing Parallel Corpus for Chinese-English Intertranslation Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the development of network technology, natural language technology has also flourished, and translation methods based on large-scale corpora have developed rapidly. Bilingual corpora has become an indispensable and important resource for research on machine translation, machine-assisted translation and translation knowledge acquisition. This paper constructs a parallel corpus of Chinese-English translation based on Web, obtains corpus from massive Web resources, and improves the level of Chinese-English translation. The corpus acquisition based on web crawler technology studied in this paper creates conditions for acquiring large-scale Chinese-English translation corpus. Sentence alignment based on Attention-BiLSTM technology can give full play to the role of machine learning. The index construction based on Lucence technology is suitable for fulltext retrieval of document sets, and solves the application problem of massive corpus.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking of Quadcopter using Type-2 Fuzzy-aided Supertwisting Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The design and operation of the fuzzy logic and supertwisting algorithm based controllers are discussed in this paper. One of the effective controllers for dealing with nonlinear systems that contain uncertainties and are vulnerable to external disturbances is the type-2 fuzzy controller and adaptive sliding mode controller. Since COVID-19, quadcopter unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) have played a significant role in society by distributing food and medications. However, the quadcopter system needs a strong, reliable controller to handle any outside disturbances that may be present during flight. This study uses a sliding mode controller with a super-twisting algorithm-based fuzzy controller to address the quadcopter trajectory tracking problem. The type-2 fuzzy controller is primarily used to reduce the effects of uncertainty because it offers superior handling of linguistic uncertainty by modeling the unreliability of information. The supertwisting sliding mode controller is an improved version of the traditional sliding mode controller that reduces settling time and eliminates chattering.

articleTitle: Classification of Brain Tumors Using Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: A brain tumor is an anomalous blowup of cells if not dually detected. A brain excrescence must be found as soon as possible for therapeutic use and survival chances. There are numerous different types of brain tumors with different features, sizes, and treatment choices. Tumor detection manually is difficult, laborious, and prone to mistakes. In this research, deep features are extracted and passed to an ensemble system of AlexNet, EfficientNet, ResNet50, InceptionV3, and VGG16 from which a score vector is acquired from Softmax for demarcation between glioma, meningioma, pituitary, and no tumor. The issues in the published studies have already been estimated on a standard dataset such as Kaggle, 2020-BRATS. The model has detection scores of more than 96%, which shows that the proposed ensemble model outperforms existing works.

articleTitle: Research on Information Security of Network Accounting Based on the Combination of Apriori and AOI Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The development of computer networks has also revolutionized the traditional accounting discipline. The cybernetic nature of network accounting determines that information security is the key to network accounting. The risk of accounting information system mainly comes from three aspects: firstly, the network’s accounting information storage has changed the traditional information storage mode, replacing the traditional paper mode with electronic storage, thus the information storage faces significant risks and the relevant data may be lost at any time; secondly, with the continuous development of Internet technology, computer and system viruses have many changing forms and types, making them difficult to identify and likewise Finally, in the network accounting information system, all data transmission relies on network or hardware storage devices, and the risk of data being stolen and illegally used during data transmission increases. In this paper, we will analyse the main security issues in the current development of network accounting and achieve the most effective protection of accounting data by introducing network accounting information based on a combination of Apriori and AOI algorithms. An analytical approach based on the meaning and logic of the APRIORI algorithm and the AOI algorithm, through algorithm implementation, and a general description of the process design based on APRIORI and AOI is given.

articleTitle: Service System Design of New Media Information Collection and Publishing Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The information collection and release system is an important product of the new media era, it can effectively solve the problems of data storage and management in traditional media, and provide users with more efficient and convenient services. With the development of new media technology, information collection and publishing platforms are constantly updated, traditional manual management has been unable to satisfy users’ data processing and query, and artificial intelligence needs to be used to solve these problems. In order to obtain a more intelligent service system for new media information collection and release, this study takes Jinwan website network as an example, starts from the service function of the system, takes information collection, processing and release as the perspective, and proposes the design of digital media resource management and release system based on artificial intelligence. Firstly, the system design requirements are analyzed in detail, and then the overall framework of the system is designed according to the requirements by adopting a hierarchical method. Finally, each functional module in the system is introduced and realized in detail. The research shows that the construction system of this research has certain feasibility, which has laid a solid foundation for the realization of media transformation, thereby promoting the Chinese information collection platform to fulfill user needs more efficiently and conveniently.

articleTitle: Implementation of Comprehensive Ability Evaluation System for Business Comprehensive Ability Evaluation Based on Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the increasing demand for business English talents, how to evaluate the effect of business English Teaching (ET) effectively has attracted increasing attention. Traditional evaluation methods are time-consuming and labor-intensive, and at the same time problems such as incomplete information and delayed feedback go along with them. In regard to this situation, this paper proposes to construct a comprehensive ability evaluation (CAE) system for business ET based on the perspective of intelligent algorithm. The article first states the current situation of business ET, then discusses the role of teaching CAE. Next it studies the application of intelligent algorithms, and on this basis, tests for the security of the evaluation system have been conducted. The test results show that the system has a high utilization rate of resources, which means the system can aid students’ learning effectively. Also, the system runs well, has high security, and is convenient to operate, which can help teachers master students’ learning situation and improve teaching level with efficiency.

articleTitle: TS Fuzzy Controller for Power Quality Improvement in Grid-connected PV and Wind Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The vast growth of demand for the electric power leads to look forward for the alternate source of energy. The most common and popular energy sources like solar and wind are acquiring their predominance due to the fact that the energy conversion from these sources using the respective means helps in the energy conversion. The photovoltaic (PV) and Permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) are the possible means of electric energy conversions from these solar and wind. The nature of the solar and wind are not uniform and forecasting the behavior of these is also not easy to perform. Due to the non-uniformity of both solar and wind there a requirement of energy storage device like battery, the unpredictable behavior of these sources may not be controlled, this may affect the outcome from energy conversion devices like PV and PMSG. To have the proper and uniform supply from both PV and PMSG, power electronic converters are required and these converters are gaining their importance due to their sophisticated operation. For these converters controllers like PI (Proportional Integral), and Takagi Sugeno-Fuzzy (TS-Fuzzy) etc. are incorporated towards the either side of the mentioned power transmission system. Loss minimization and reactive power compensation are majorly focused here, using the TS-Fuzzy controllers to the power electronic converters.

articleTitle: Write Driver for Low Power Consumption in Magnetic Tunnel Junction (MTJ) Circuits
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Magnetic tunneljunction (MTJ) circuits play major role in various memory applications. Read and write operations are the basic operations required for any memory. Spin transfer torque is considered for the MTJ with a supply voltage of 1.3 volts. Read and write operations are analyzed with the proposed write driver which has 49 transistors is designed in CMOS cadence technology. Write detector, enable circuits help in achieving low power consumption at the expense of area. Hence, a trade off between power and area is possible with the proposed write driver for MTJ circuits.

articleTitle: Teaching Resource Sharing System in OBE Mode Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The association rule method describes the rules of the relationship between data items in the database, and explores the association relationship between variables through the confidence and support degree. Depending on the appearance of some items in a transaction, other items in the same transaction can be derived, that is, relationships hidden in the data or associations between each other. In this paper, an OBE teaching resource sharing system based on data mining technology is designed, and a mathematical model consisting of the definition of distance between rules, extraction of user preference features, similarity calculation and generation of recommendation results is constructed. According to the business process, the system function composed of teaching resource collection, teaching resource processing, teaching resource storage, teaching resource mining, teaching resource recommendation, teaching resource retrieval and teaching resource statistics is constructed. And the specific function is explained.

articleTitle: A Review of Knowledge Reasoning Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of digitalization, all kinds of data on the Internet have increased rapidly, and knowledge graphs have emerged. Knowledge graphs have become one of the important means for us to manage and utilize knowledge. Knowledge reasoning is part of building a knowledge graph. There are many different methods of knowledge reasoning, which are mainly divided into traditional knowledge reasoning and knowledge reasoning over knowledge graph. The knowledge reasoning manner based on neural network has stronger thinking ability and generalization ability. The inference effect is better. The utilization rate of the relation, entity, attribute and text information in the knowledge base is higher. In this paper, the basic ideas of knowledge graph are introduced in detail. The basic principle of knowledge reasoning is expounded. In addition, from the three dimensions of semantics, structure and auxiliary storage. Three inference methods are introduced. Furthermore, the problems of neural network are summarized, and the challenges of knowledge reasoning are described. Finally, The development prospect of neural network and knowledge reasoning are prospected.

articleTitle: Convolution Neural Network Model with Feature Linked Vector for Oral Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: One of the most common types of cancer, oral cancer is notorious for its high mortality rate due to its tendency to be diagnosed late. Cancers of a lips, tongue, cheeks, the floor of the mouth, tough as well as taste buds, nostrils, and glottis are all considered types of oral cancer. It is impossible to stop the uncontrollable multiplication of cancerous cells in the mouth, and the resulting mutations have the potential to spread to nearby organs. Low-cost and early disease diagnosis may be possible through the detection of vigilant tumors in the oral fissure. We’ve used deep ML algorithms for diagnosis of oral cancer. The information gathered in this study is used to evaluate deep learning-based machine vision strategies for detecting and classifying oral lesions in the interest of early cancer detection. To detect oral cancer in photographs, we trained a deep learning algorithm on a cascade of Convolution neural networks. High detection accuracy for oral cancer compared to earlier models.

articleTitle: AI-based Confidence Level Estimation System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Confidence is an important quality that everyone should strive to possess. It is belief in oneself and one’s abilities. Estimation of human confidence using artificial intelligence (AI) is a growing area of research that seeks to develop algorithm and model. Using machine learning algorithms, this system can accurately estimate a person’s level of confidence. The system considers various factors such as face-direction, facial expression, eye movement and speech patterns to determine the confidence level of the speaker. This research is motivated by the potential applications of this technology in field of recruitment, education, and neuroscience. Proposed system will be trained on large datasets of individuals with varying levels of confidence to improve its accuracy and performance. The output will be categorical value that represents the confidence level of the individual, which can be used to evaluate their performance in various settings, such as job interviews, public speaking& many more. Our system will also be able to provide explanations for its predictions, enabling users to understand how the system arrived at its confidence level estimation. This abstract provides an overview of the current state of the art in this field and discusses some of the challenges and opportunities that lie ahead. Overall, our proposed AI-based Confidence level Estimator has a potential in the field of decision making, and we believe that it has significant role for behavioral analysis in the domain of AI.

articleTitle: Orientation of Digital Transformation of Power Grid Enterprises by Digital Innovation Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The ability of enterprises to create and use new technologies is critical to their success. This paper aims to study orientation of digital transformation (DT) of power grid enterprises by digital innovation technology. The transformation focuses on technology and becomes a mere formality, which leads to serious homogenization. Without accurately grasping the Internet thinking, we still use the traditional thinking of running newspapers to deal with the digital operation of power grid enterprises; Wrong positioning of its own functions and market, failing to accurately assess the advantages of power grid enterprises and market changes under the Internet environment. In view of the above problems, this paper puts forward some suggestions: the digital operation of power grid enterprises should reposition their functions and markets with the flow thinking and the thinking of serving users; Reorganize the structure of power grid enterprise groups according to the standards of Internet enterprises, and participate in market competition as market players; The digital operation of power grid enterprises must create unique value points, stick to users with personalized products, and be at the core of the industrial chain.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data Classification Algorithm in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In the process of agricultural production, a large number of data are produced, these data are managed and classified reasonably and effectively, and their internal laws are found, which provides scientific basis and reference for the development of agricultural modernization, to help agricultural production, management, management, to achieve the organic integration of big data and agriculture [1]. In this paper, the principles of Bayes, K-nearest neighbor algorithm, decision tree and other common classification algorithms are discussed, and the application of big data classification in agriculture is studied.

articleTitle: Analysis of Regional Safety Index Based on Public Data: Focusing on Suwon City
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to analyze the correlation between the regional safety index, urban space, and time series data, to analyze the causes of vulnerable areas by subdividing the regional safety index, and to derive solutions. Public data was used for analysis, and spatial data such as police stations, security bells, and security facilities, and time-series and spatial composite data such as the number of police reports by time zone and floating population were used. In addition, Suwon, Gyeonggi-do, the city to be analyzed, is a large city with a population of over 1 million. It is located near Seoul and has a very high floating population as there are various landmarks, such as Samsung Electronics headquarters and Suwon Hwaseong, in the city. Therefore, it is an excellent city to analyze multiple characteristics that are difficult to obtain in other cities. To obtain various insights, we analyzed multiple methods, and in particular, techniques such as exploratory data analysis, visualization analysis, and machine learning were used.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Anti-Epidemic System Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In order to improve the protection of epidemic prevention during the epidemic situation, strengthen the management of epidemic prevention materials, and reduce the risk of epidemic spread caused by the flow of people and materials; In this paper, the intelligent anti-epidemic system is designed by using the technology of face recognition and infrared temperature measurement, the first step is to carry out intelligent detection, and the second step is to carry out face recognition, adding the function of infrared temperature measurement in the process of face recognition,, the results of the experiment show that the accuracy of face recognition is 97.69% and the accuracy of temperature detection is also relatively high Compared with the simple application of face recognition in the field of identity verification, the added functions of infrared temperature measurement and intelligent detection meet the special needs of the epidemic period, and can be applied to a wide range of practical scenes, can effectively solve the epidemic prevention process is too complex, real-time is not high, and so on.

articleTitle: Survey on Liver Disease Prediction and Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Liver is one among the crucial organs of a human body. If the liver’s normal functioning is compromised it leads to liver disease. The way people live today has completely changed, and many of them consume alcohol, unhealthy foods, energy drinks, self-medication, and other things like environmental pollution. And some of them continue to engage in these activities daily. Human livers will be severely damaged by this, and much suffering will result. Particularly heavy drinking makes many people more susceptible to liver failure and makes living a perilous life for them. The liver is the most important organ in humans, performing a wide range of tasks such as bile generation, bile and bilirubin excretion, protein and carbohydrate metabolism, enzyme activation, glycogen storage, vitamin and mineral absorption, plasma protein synthesis, and the manufacture of clotting factors. As a result, it is increasingly crucial to detect diseases at an early stage, as doing so enables the use of early, low-dose treatments to help prevent disease. However, because the signs of liver illness at the beginning are so minimal, it is too difficult to detect it. Machine learning holds great promise for automated disease diagnosis. The discovery and treatment of illnesses have undergone a complete transformation this is because of machine learning development in medicine. Machine learning model application in healthcare research includes knowledge extraction and decision support.

articleTitle: Compressor using Cadence 180nm for Image Processing Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Magnetic Compressors play major role in image processing and microwave applications. AND-OR complex compound gates and XOR-XNOR modules are used to design compressor to achieve low power consumption and less hardware complexity using cadence 180nm technology. The waveforms of the compressor are analyzed for its better logical performance over conventional compressors.

articleTitle: Hexagonal Split Ring Resonator for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This research design presents microstrip-patchantenna(MPA) for many shapes of antenna, in this paper with and without cuts ofHexagonal Split Ring Resonator at24.5 GHz for 5G applications. The substrate, FR4, has a relative permittivity of 4.4 and a height of 1.6 mm, respectively used in Microstrip feed. The designs are simulated using Ansys HFSS Software, and the antenna parameters, such as gain, SII& VSWR, band width, and directivity, have been researched. According to the results, when the number of rings increases, resonance is attained at the high of gain with a bandwidth ranging from 223. 2MHz to 1021. 5MHz at the very least.

articleTitle: Analytical Evaluation of Web Performance Testing Tools: Apache JMeter and SoapUI
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Computing on the Web is based on distributed system applications that use the client-server architecture. Since web-based applications have been beta-tested, the quality criteria cannot be fixed. Whenever a website is launched, the question is always raised as to how many HTTP requests of users can the website handle at once. As part of this paper, various tools for performance testing will be used, including Apache SoapUI, JMeter, etc., and selection tools for load testing will be discussed.

articleTitle: Accounting Resource Sharing Management System Based on Data Analysis Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The development of information technology has gradually matured, and the development of accounting has also gone through several stages. In the future, it will further develop towards intelligence. At present, the financial shared service center is widely used in group enterprise management. It not only realizes financial transformation, releases manpower, and reduces personnel pressure, but also manages relatively complete financial information in a unified manner. At the same time, the financial shared service center usually includes a complete system platform, which realizes data sharing through the connection with external systems, which greatly facilitates the business connection management of group enterprises. The main purpose of this paper is to design and research the accounting resource sharing MS based on the data analysis algorithm. In the experimental analysis stage, the AIMS is in the state of 480 concurrent users, the average data query response time is 4.2, the average data access response time is 5.0, and the average execution data scale per second is 103.51. Therefore, it can be judged that the performance test results meet the expected goals and are suitable for the accounting business needs of enterprises of different scales.

articleTitle: Building a System based on C2C e-Commerce Website Credit Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In today’s increasingly developed Internet, ecommerce has become an extremely popular form, especially in my country, due to the rapid economic development, the development form and content of e-commerce are becoming more and more mature. And the credit evaluation model is a crucial link in the whole process of e-commerce. In order to solve the problems existing in the existing e-commerce website credit evaluation model, the system adopts the MVC architecture and the fuzzy comprehensive credit evaluation model, and introduces each functional module and model overview of the system in detail. The process of analysis and system evaluation shows that the system has excellent applicable value. The system test shows that the buyer’s evaluation rate can affect the credit of the e-commerce platform after the transaction is successful, and the transaction amount has little effect on the credit of the e-commerce platform, so it proves that the credit evaluation system has certain feasibility.

articleTitle: EEG Based Brain Computer Interface System for Decoding Covert Speech using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
