abstract: The study aims to learn deep features from EEG signals corresponding to the imagery of words to design a BCI(Brain computer interface) system based on human thoughts. Topological plots of time-averaged EEG signals across all the trials corresponding to the imagery of a particular word are fed as input to the designed deep neural network algorithm. Designed deep learning architecture has an amalgamation of the Two-dimensional convolutional neural network and LSTM that takes the assistance of the capabilities and assets of both neural network architectures. The proposed neural network architecture achieves admirable accuracy in identifying imagined words from the EEG-based Kara one dataset. The accuracy of the designed CNN-LSTM model with topological plots as input features was 20-25% more than chance level accuracy and comparable to the state of arts.

articleTitle: Ensemble model for Detecting Phishing and Trojan using Latest Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Machine learning is significant fourth industrial revolution technology that may be habitual to defend Internetconnected devices against cyber threats, assaults, damage, or illegal access. Cyber security computing may become more automated and intelligent than conventional security systems due to security intelligence modeling. Using an ensemble model of machine learning and deep learning, the objective of the proposed work is to identify phishing and Trojan attacks. In this ensemble method, we used the VGG-16 and Random Forest classifier and evaluate the performance to detect the attack. In this work, we have also shown the comparison of the proposed method with the existing attack.

articleTitle: Research Progress of Machine Learning in Software Defect Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Software defect prediction is of great significance to ensuring software security. Appropriate metrics are an effective way to predict whether a program contains software flaws. In recent years, machine learning techniques have been widely used to measure programs to predict software defects and have achieved good results. In order to clarify the research progress of software defect prediction based on machine learning, this paper reviews the research results in this field in the past three years from two aspects: within-project defect prediction and cross-project defect prediction. Firstly, the software defect prediction framework based on machine learning and its development are introduced. Secondly, this paper summarizes the research results in the field of defect prediction in the past three years from two aspects: within-project defect prediction and cross-project defect prediction. Finally, based on the research results so far, the status and hot spots of machine learning in software defect prediction are discussed, which provides possible help for the development direction of machine learning in software defect prediction.

articleTitle: Designing 64-Bit LUT based FFT Structure for High-Speed DSP Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Digital signal Processing (DSP) utilizes The efficient Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) Methodology that is used to alter, filter, and decode digital audio, video, and image data. FFT is used to design Electrical Circuits, to solve differential equations, to analyze signals and to process images. Distributed Arithmetic (DA) is a multiplier-less implementation technique that computes the inner dot product between two signals-fixed and varying by using shifters and adders. It takes the values in a bit-serial fashion which suits for real-time processing. The Computation Logic Blocks (CLBs) of Field Programmable Gate Anays (FPGAs) Utilize Distributed Arithmetic. FFT can be calculated using the DA method. The existing method to calculate FFT is based on complex multiplications and additions which consume time as well as power. Hence DA based FFT has been proposed in which the delay is 29.3% less and the power is 21.8% less than that of the existing method.

articleTitle: Sensor-Based Open Channel Blockage Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Traditional method of drainage cleaning takes place manually. With manual process, the road side drains get cleaned for once in two months. This irregular cleaning of drains leads to blockage of drainages and effecting people’s lives severely. According to the information about the international distribution of open drains, if the drains are left unchecked, they become a health hazard to the neighbouring people as they become a breeding ground for disease-causing parasites and other microorganisms. And when the rainy season begins, the unclean drains can rapidly spread waterborne diseases and infections. Also, the gutter system gets clogged due to heavy rains. So, the water will flow over the side of the gutters which results in traffic and road accidents. The main problem here is the information is not sent to the higher authorities whether the drains are regularly cleaned or not. To eradicate this condition, the status is sent to the higher authorities like these drains are not cleaned well and these should be cleaned. Though this information, they can contact the worker and make them to clean the drains. This continuous cleaning of drains makes the humans lives much easier and safe. So, the occurrence of insect infected diseases to the residents, rain water blockage on the roads will be diminished.

articleTitle: Identifying Abnormal Corporate Financial Data Based on the Comparison of SVM and Logistic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the continuous development of Chinese market economy, Chinese enterprises are facing more and more complicated and fierce challenges if they want to get new opportunities for development in the market. In the market economy environment, the competition between enterprises is fierce. This paper aims to study the abnormal financial data identification based on SVM and Logistic algorithm. Through the research results of SVM, Logistic algorithm and financial identification index at home and abroad, the idea of constructing this model is clarified. In the construction of the enterprise financial abnormal data identification model, 90 enterprises as research objects to identify financial anomalies. The experimental results show that the recognition results are stable and the accuracy is high with SVM modeling, but the accuracy is decreased after the addition of non-financial data. Compared with SVM, Logistic has a lower accuracy in this problem.

articleTitle: Multiband Tree shaped Microstrip Antenna for Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this paper, a multiband microstrip patch antenna is designed that can operate at multiple frequencies, including 8.27GHz (X-band), 14GHz (Satellite communication), 20.2 and 24.3GHz (K-band), and 29.7GHz (ka-band). An antenna’s radiating element is supported by a 0.15mm thicker Roger RT/duorid 5880 substrate with a loss tangent $\delta$ of 9×10<sup>-4</sup> and a dielectric constant of 2.2. The antenna matched with a VSWR <2 in the five frequency bands. An antenna exhibits good impedance matching, radiation characteristics and gain across their operational bandwidths. This can be used for the applications of Satellite communications and radar.

articleTitle: A Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO) Design and VLSI Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Anyone who designs, manufactures, or repairs electronic equipment needs to have access to oscilloscopes. Because of their precision, portability, high resolution, fast speed, data-holding capabilities, and so on, digital oscilloscopes are frequently utilized these days. Oscilloscopes are essential for overcoming today’s difficult measurement issues since they serve as the engineer’s eyes. However, the cost of an oscilloscope is pretty high. In contrast to standard oscilloscopes, which have vast dimensions, the DSO designed and developed in this project will have smaller dimensions. An oscilloscope’s performance is determined by its capacity to measure accurately, its efficiency, how much it costs, and other factors that may be determined by comparing it to other oscilloscopes currently available on the market. Therefore, this manuscript has explained how to design a low-cost, efficient, portable oscilloscope using an FPGA board named Basys-3 from Digilent. The whole system consists of a FPGA board and a monitor only, as shown in Fig. 1. However, we can determine the sort of signal we are receiving by analyzing the flashing pattern of all 16 LEDs on the Basys-3 board, as well as the peak to peak voltage, maximum voltage, and minimum voltage on the monitor. Depending on how much information we need about a signal, we may choose whether or not to use a monitor. To convert the analog input signal and store the signal or waveform in digital representation, the Basys-3 board’s inbuilt xadc and block RAM were employed. The flexibility of this reasonably priced oscilloscope gadget make it appropriate for use as a resource tool for engineering students of circuital branches.

articleTitle: Image Filtering and Utilization of Deep Learning Algorithms to Detect the Severity of Diabetic Retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy is a leading cause of blindness in adults, particularly in those with poorly controlled diabetes. It affects around 93 million people globally and is classified into two main categories: nonproliferative and proliferative. Early detection and treatment are crucial to prevent vision loss, but the current gold standard for diagnosis, fundus photography, has limitations such as requiring specialized equipment and trained personnel, and patient cooperation. To address these issues, this research develops a web application that uses CNN algorithms to effectively diagnose the severity of diabetic retinopathy. The web application, FundusNet, was developed through a multi-phase process using transfer learning and a dataset of fundus images. The proposed hybrid model (based on EfficientNETB7 and VGG-16 using Laplacian Sharpening) was found to have an accuracy of 91.8% and a F1 score of 91.5. FundusNet is free, easy to use, and does not require internet access, making it a convenient and scalable solution for diabetic retinopathy detection, especially in resource-limited settings.

articleTitle: Enhanced authentication system with robust features for the secure user template
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Biometrics has evolved into a crucial instrument for a user’s authentication in the modern world. Biometrics is gaining prominence as a method of authentication and is a viable alternative to existing methods. One of the most prevalent biometric traits is fingerprint recognition. It is quite accurate and societally acceptable. Despite their popularity, fingerprint-based biometrics have certain security problems. The minutia points in a fingerprint serve as a template, and the database stores the user template during enrolment. Many studies have proven that constructing an original fingerprint from such a user’s template is doable. In fingerprint-based authentication mechanisms. This is a significant security risk and has become a big issue. The proposed method is an extension of Sharma et al.’s technique. They create a three-dimensional user template using a person’s fingerprint. We have enhanced their technique through the modification of the user template. The template is modified by adding the minutia point information considering the unique point as the fourth dimension of the template for users using a user key set. Hence, we proposed a 4-dimensional user template created using the user’s fingerprint. In case of a template getting compromised, a new template involves the use of a fresh set of user keys that can be generated from the same fingerprint. The FVC2002 [DB1], FVC2002 [DB2], and FVC2002 [DB3] fingerprint databases were used to evaluate our method. The results achieved are extremely encouraging and shows the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Security and Privacy Preservation for Future Vehicular Transportation Systems: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Electric Vehicles (EVs) with numerous optimized features are becoming more popular in today’s world of vehicle technology. This is especially in these days when climate change is becoming more of a concern, and the usage of renewable energy is promoted. These EVs require frequent charging for daily use, and the usage of different charging stations would store sensitive data about EVs, e.g., location, driver’s license, etc. This leads to significant privacy and security concerns. In this paper, we will investigate the existing solutions proposed in the literature to address these concerns. Some of these solutions are implementing a framework that depends on cryptography and the Matching Market, where cryptography plays a vital role in securing user information privacy. Other solutions include implementing a secure and privacy-preserving physical layer-assisted scheme for charging stations to improve authentication and preserve user privacy. Finally, we provide a comprehensive comparison of the existing works, followed by our recommendations for future research directions to enhance the security level for future electric vehicle transportation systems.

articleTitle: A Review of Privacy-Preserving Authentication Schemes for Future Internet of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The Vehicle to Grid (V2G) network relationship is complex and contradictory in nature. For the grid to authenticate electric vehicles (EVs) and allow them to enter safely, they need a certain set of information that is personal to the EV. Unfortunately, as this information is often transmitted, it can be intercepted by unauthorized or malicious viewers, leaving EVs in a vulnerable position. In this paper, we explore existing solutions proposed in the literature to address these concerns. Authentication mechanisms are often combined with a key exchange between local aggregators (LAGs) and EVs, without the use of pseudonyms, to reduce the overhead associated with authentication. This scheme ensures anonymity, confidentiality, unlinkability, nonrepudiation, traceability, and revocation. Further, physical unclonable functions can be used to reduce the overhead of authentication. A three-layered infrastructure can also be used in which an EV only needs to authenticate once when entering a section of the grid. We conclude by providing a comparison of current works and making suggestions for further study to enhance the security of future electric vehicle transportation systems.

articleTitle: Hyperledger Fabric Enabled Vaccine Intelligent Network to Implement Immunization Program
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Blockchain is a disruptive technology and incredibly popular nowadays based on decentralized ledger technology. It is a tampered-proof technology that saves the transaction data permanently in a distributed ledger with an immutable time-stamped series record of data, and it is built on the idea of a peer-to-peer network. Blockchain efficiently creates trust between people and machines. It provides new approaches and solutions that cater to the business demands oriented to the fourth industrial revolution. Healthcare is one of the key research use case of blockchain wherein health records are required to be electronic for e-governance. In this paper, we propose the blockchain based Vaccine Intelligent Network for pregnant women, included vaccines covered under the Universal Immunization Program. Our solution is based on the Hyperledger Fabric framework to develop the Electronic Immunization Record of vaccinated pregnant women. The proposed system transforms the immunization record from paper to a reliable digital platforms that will benefit all nation citizens and further reduce anomalies.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Algorithm for Earthquake Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this paper, we are trying to predict the Earthquake before it happens using seismic indicators anywhere around the world. It is an important task, on detecting seismic events from seismic time series using machine learning techniques. When we train a dataset for any one location it should also be applicable to detect at the other locations. Earthquakes are one of the most dangerous and deadly natural disasters. It is very important for the safety of all human beings as well as all the animals living on the planet to predict the earthquake way before it is going to happen. The population of the earth is increasing at a very rapid rate so the human population is also settling in the areas where the region is at very high risk of earthquakes which also causes more people to be affected by the impact of the earthquakes and more people to die. During this research various machine learning techniques were used such as Support Vector Machine, Random Forest, Neural Network, Convolutional Neural Network, Quantum Machine Learning, K-Nearest Neighbor, Machine Learning Risk Prediction Algorithm, Deep learning Model, and Regression.

articleTitle: Scenario Modelling of Country’s Region Development with Artificial Intelligence Support
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The paper describes the modern control (governance, management) science approach to the socioeconomic development of a country’s region (province, subject, municipality) in the context of public administration. Proven methods for strategic goal setting, scenario and economic modelling with artificial intelligence support based on opportunity assessing and system optimisation are presented. The region is given as an integrated object for control. Strategic planning uses hierarchy analysis methods. The experience of scenario modelling, evaluation, and selection of priority scenarios of the region’s socioeconomic development with estimating the current economic indicators of the region is represented. The deep learning approach and big data analysis help to verify and automatically create scenario models under team members’ control. The proposed methodology has a significant approbation in the real sector of the economy.

articleTitle: Analysis Of Optimum Cost And Size Of The Hybrid Power Generation System Using Optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The demand for electrical power increases all over the world because of developments in all sectors. To fulfill the load demand most countries depend on thermal power plants because they supply around 52 -56% of total generated power in all sectors. The cost of power generated at thermal power plants increases, since coal is the main fuel for thermal power plants hence total generation cost is affected by the use of much coal. Also if used much coal for power generation it also emits toxic gases and pollutes the environment. power generation at a low cost and also reduce the environmental emission it is required to combine the renewable power generation system with the thermal power plant. So adopting the hybrid power generation system in the current scenario is the most effective, efficient, and economical system. The hybrid system is also very useful for the remote areas where electrical power supply is available randomly. This work simulates the different available power generation systems like wind, solar, diesel, and thermal plants and tries to find out which combination of the generation system is most economical for the same load demand. This work simulates various interconnected hybrid systems such as 1) PV and diesel systems 2) PV and wind systems, and 3) PV, wind, and diesel generator systems. The motive is to simulate the different systems and find out comparative results so that we can understand which system is most feasible for our work. The comparison of these proposed systems is done on the basis of different economic indicators like initial capital of the plant, operating cost, net present generation cost, and cost of energy.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influencing Factors of Equipment Life Cycle Based on TOPSIS-AISM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy and society, power grid needs the optimal comprehensive benefit of integrating performance, cost and risk control. To pay attention to the life-cycle management of assets, adopt the TOPSIS-AISM combined model, introduce the AISM method, visually present the ranking results of TOPSIS, combine with Pearson correlation analysis, find out the influencing factors of the indicators, calculate the impact degree, and perform the advantages and advantages grading, which is in line with the requirements of the sustainable development direction of the enterprise. It can effectively reduce the overall operating cost of equipment assets and create greater social and economic benefits for enterprises.

articleTitle: Accurate Brain Tumor Segmentation and Detection using Multi-Task Learning with GlobalNet and FusionNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Accurate and quick brain tumor diagnosis and treatment are critical for the successful management of these disorders, which can have a substantial influence on an individual’s quality of life and even be deadly. This work describes a novel technique for brain tumor segmentation and classification that employs three deep learning architectures: GlobalNet, Multi-task Learning, and FusionNet. GlobalNet is a convolutional neural network that incorporates global context information into the model via a global pooling layer, whereas Multi-task Learning allows the model to do numerous tasks concurrently, enhancing each task’s performance by using shared knowledge among them. FusionNet is a deep fully residual convolutional neural network that combines information extracted from multiple CNNs trained on various medical imaging modalities to improve the accuracy and resilience of brain tumor segmentation. The proposed method is shown to be robust and accurate in segmenting and categorizing brain tumors, providing an effective solution with better accuracy in predicting the brain tumors and segmenting the affected part.

articleTitle: A new Polynomial based Symmetric Key Algorithm using Polynomial Interpolation Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The main attributes of a security framework are Confidentiality, Authentication, and Data integrity. There are two main standards of cryptography algorithms categorized as private or symmetric and public or asymmetric algorithms, symmetric algorithms use one secret key to encrypt and decrypt payloads, the list includes Data Encryption Standard (DES), Advanced Encryption Standard (AES), RC5, Blowfish, and others, and asymmetric algorithms use key pairs consists of public and private keys, RSA, and Elliptic Curve Cryptography are two best examples of the same. In spite of their successful implementations, these standards suffer from various attacks, and the beginning of large-scale quantum is the biggest threat to the commonly used cryptography algorithms. In general, Public-key cryptography relies upon mathematical problems that are hard to be broken with the available computational power but it is believed that quantum computers can break them at polynomial solvable time in future. Quantum-safe cryptography refers to a new generation of algorithms that are resilient against attacks launched by both classical and quantum computers. This work designs and implements a novel cryptography standard using polynomial interpolations to make it both supercomputer and quantum safe.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Heterogeneous Hybrid Model for Fake News Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In fact, fake news has a huge impact on every aspect of our lives, including politics, finance, education, democracy and business. Our aim is to help and provide ability to the users to classify fake real news and avoid the harm of spread unreal news. In our project, we have provided an optimal solution to detect fake news by using an ensemble hybrid model that is a combination of different classifiers: Naive Bayes Classifier, K –Nearest Neighbor classifier, Decision Tree, Bagging Decision Tree, Boosting Decision Tree, Random Forest, Logistic Regression and Support Vector Machine. To implement these classifiers, we have used the Sci-Kit Learn python library. To implement our work, we have used google colab online platform. In our proposed model, for data preprocessing, we have used Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK) technique and for feature extraction, we have used a famous vectorizer called as ‘Term Frequency - Inverse Document Frequency’ (TF-IDF). Then in data segmentation, we’ve splited our dataset into two sets: training set (80%) and testing set (20%). Conclusion: Using the proposed model, the accuracy on the test dataset is 99.13%, with precision of 99.42%, recall of 98.85%, and fl-score of 99.13%.

articleTitle: Prediction of Droughts using SPEI
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Accurate assessment of drought occurrences is crucial for mitigating the negative impacts of drought events on groundwater sources, agriculture, and ecosystems. Machine learning algorithms are useful for drought prediction because they are simpler, faster, and require fewer data points than dynamic models. Vegetation can become visibly dry, and water levels in reservoirs and lakes can drop, as a direct result of a drought. In the long run, it may be more expensive to manage effects like subsidence, seawater intrusion, as well as ecosystem damage. The social and economic harm caused by drought can be greatly mitigated if we have the ability to monitor water shortages in near real time as well as provide precise drought forecasting from weeks to seasons. There are a number of ways in which drought indices can be tracked and predicted. Historically, PDSI and SPI have been used to foretell drought zones. Standardized Precipitation Evaporation Index) is now being used to make reliable drought forecasts. Index (SPEI) (SPEI). Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTMs) are just two examples of the machine learning techniques that are examined to determine how well they work for drought prediction. The purpose of this study is to determine which model (a combination of several lag times) will be most accurate in predicting future values of the standardised precipitation index (SPI) and the standardised precipitation and evapotranspiration index (SPEI). Using a random forest (RF) model with lag durations of 1–12 months, drought was predicted. The accuracy of SPI and SPEI’s predictions will rise when the time frame is extended. SPEI is better than SPI in predicting droughts because its overall accuracy (OA) will rise and its mistakes (i.e., overestimate (OE) and underestimate (UE)) will decline.

articleTitle: Analysis of Energy Efficient Workflow Allocation in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Growing demand for high performance computing such as cloud since exponential increase data and computing complexity. Cloud provides elastic and on-demand provisioning of high performance computing capabilities using a pay-per-use paradigm, which over the past few years has seen a rapid increase in its usage by scientists and engineers. Many applications consist of many cooperating tasks requiring more processing power than a single computer can provide. Scientific workflows, big data processing workflows and multitier web service workflows are known to be the examples of these applications. Workflow scheduling is an actively researched area in the IaaS cloud environment. Such applications are a big problem that require attention since they required high performance computing and consume excessive amount of energy in cloud data centers. Massive energy use in cloud data centers has an adverse effect on the environment and raises operational costs. As a result, it cannot be ignored. While satisfying the Quality-of-Service constraints set by the user, effective scheduling techniques can considerably reduce energy consumption. Due to the NP-hard nature of the problem, researchers have spent a lot of time studying cloud workflow scheduling. In this study, we offer an overview of existing research for workflow scheduling algorithm in the cloud environments. It provides a perceptive of heuristic and meta heuristic approaches used to solve workflow scheduling. This excerpt is from a full-text study that conducts a thorough analysis of the literature on workflow application in relation to cloud computing. By responding to the three research questions, initial findings are given. 96 research papers were reviewed, and 24 articles were chosen. This study explores that there is a need to find an energy efficient workflow allocation strategy while complying Quality-of-Service parameters set by the user.

articleTitle: Kernelized Deep Networks for Speech Signal Segmentation Using Clustering and Artificial Intelligence in Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Speech signal segmentation is a key component of speech processing tasks, such as speaker recognition, speech recognition, and emotion recognition. Traditional approaches often have low accuracy and high computational complexity. To address this issue, we propose a novel approach using kernelized deep networks. The method utilizes Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) and Linear Predictive Coding (LPC) for feature extraction, with Spectral subtraction, wavelet denoising and Wiener filtering as preprocessing techniques. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) are used for dimensionality reduction. Spectral clustering using the graph Laplacian and normalized Laplacian matrix is then employed to cluster the speech signals into different segments. The Lanczos algorithm, Implicitly Restarted Arnoldi Method and Krylov subspace is used to train the networks and classify the signals. Results on TIMIT and BURN corpus demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms traditional techniques in terms of segmentation accuracy and reduces computational complexity. This research highlights the potential of kernelized deep networks for speech segmentation and contributes to the field of speech processing.

Author Keywords: Lanczos Algorithm and Implicitly Restarted Arnoldi Method (IRAM)

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling & MATLAB Simulation of STATCOM Based Profile Controller for Self Excited Induction Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: A three Phase Induction Machine can generate electrical power if the motor is rotated using mechanical power above its synchronous speed and the core of the motor having residual magnetism. The motor running in this mode is known as Self Exited Induction Generator or SEIG. SEIG inherits number of vulnerabilities and limitations such as poor power quality, poor efficiency and low power factor because of the construction of the motor, operational principal and variable speed of the prime mover. Poor Power factor and variable speed of prime mover, will produces more heating losses in rotor and will result in low system efficiency & sometime system may collapse. But in the present scenario of the tissile fuel crises, SEIG had attracted numbers of research scholars for its simplicity, robust nature and less setup cost. The presented paper investigates about the latest research in the field of SEIG to address the limitations and vulnerabilities along with the technique to improve power quality in SEIG. STATCOM stands for Static Compensator is basically an auxiliary circuit used to improve profile of SEIG. STATCOM is used as profile regulator. Mathematical model of SEIG is created along with STATCOM. MATLAB Simulation of derived mathematical model is presented in the article to test the performance of the suggested system. An effort had been put to make SEIG more efficient.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Twin in Power Grid Inspection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the wide application of deep learning technology in power grid inspection, it provides a strong guarantee for timely investigation of power grid hidden dangers and problems. However, the existing intelligent inspection technology has many problems, such as low detection accuracy, unbalanced data samples, relatively isolated inspection system and so on. It is urgent to establish a new intelligent inspection technology system. Digital twin technology can be highly integrated with advanced technologies such as Internet of Things and target detection to form effective monitoring, simulation and diagnosis of physical entities. Therefore, this paper summarizes the characteristics and technical system of digital power grid, expounds the integration application of digital twin and power grid inspection and detection, summarizes and introduces the construction method of digital twin technology in power grid operation and maintenance scenarios, and points out the problems and future directions of current digital twin application in power grid intelligent operation and maintenance. It provides a new theoretical method for intelligent patrol management of power grid facilities.

Author Keywords: power grid intelligent operation and maintenance

articleTitle: Cybersecurity Education: Understanding the knowledge gaps based on cyber security policy, challenge, and knowledge
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Cyber security is a critical aspect of modern information technology as it helps protect sensitive data, programs, files, and software from unauthorized access and potential harm from cyber attackers. This can include data theft, system disruption, or other malicious activities. To ensure a safe and secure environment, organizations and companies adopt various strategies and practices to prevent cyber-attacks. The study of cyber security involves understanding different types of cyber-attacks, their mechanisms, and the challenges that need to be overcome. With the growing use of online resources and the rapid advancement of technology, cyber security remains a top concern for individuals, businesses, and governments. Cyberattack disrupts their basic functions, causing widespread economic damage and societal disruptions. Hence, governments, organizations, and individuals must take proactive measures to address these threats and improve their cyber security posture. This involves implementing effective security policies and technologies, raising awareness of safe online practices, and investing in research and development to stay ahead of the constantly evolving cyber threats. In addition, international cooperation and collaboration among countries, industries, and communities are necessary to tackle the global challenges posed by cybercrime and cyber-attacks. organizations are working towards developing effective solutions to mitigate the risks associated with cybercrime and ensure a secure digital environment.

articleTitle: DPC: An amalgamated approach for drone package classification system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The logistics and e-commerce sectors have always incorporated parcel delivery and packing as their integral part. With the high amount of demand and supply in the domain of e-commerce, there is a high demand for drone-based delivery systems through which a certain amount of parcel packages can be delivered using drones. To assist the aforementioned domain, the proposed work aims to develop a drone package classification (DPC) system for the classification of packages according to their weight and the type of drone that can be employed to deliver the particular class of packages. The complete experiment has been executed using DL based hybrid approach consisting of convolutional neural network (CNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) technique on a self-developed package5k dataset resulting in an overall accuracy of 93.82%. The entire investigation and suggested DL-based hybrid strategy have shown to be a successful, efficient, and sustainable method for the identification and classification of drone packages to create a successful and sustainable DPC system.

articleTitle: Cognitive Solution for NextGen Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In the era of Industry 4.0, business applications are becoming complex, and hosting platforms are becoming hybrid to achieve agility and cost optimization. Moreover, end-users are demanding secure connectivity with greater speed, intelligence and enhanced experience irrespective of their physical locations. Traditional networks are also transforming from one-to-many or many-to-one, to many-to-many form of connectivity, termed hyperconnectivity. To cater to the needs of end-users and business organizations, we propose ‘Hyper Connected Networks’. It is a complete horizontal solution framework applicable across various business verticals. The entire solution comprises three unique assets -Unified Network Service Platform which brings co-existence of legacy with the NextGen networks, Security Orchestrator which brings multiple vendor platforms under one umbrella, and a Cognitive Platform which brings vendor-agnostic and application-aware networking for Wi-Fi 5/6, 5G and beyond. These assets are designed using a microservices framework and hence can be easily extended to create on-demand solutions in future.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection Using Deep Learning With Synthetic Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Early brain tumor identification is one of the most critical challenges that neurologists and radiologists face. Effective segmentation and classification still need to be improved despite numeroussignificant efforts and encouraging outcomes. Images of various sorts are employed for tumor segmentation, categorization, and diagnosis. For a noninvasive and more accurate image of the interior anatomy of the tumor, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is preferred above all other imaging techniques. Nevertheless, manually identifying and differentiating brain tumors from magnetic resonance Imaging (MRI) scans are difficult and error-prone, and it calls for the need for an automated brain tumor detection system for early tumordetection. This study suggests a deep-learning approach for analyzing MRI data in order to detect brain tumors. The suggested approach comprises three key phases: pre-processing, segmentation, adopting k means clustering, and finally, tumor classification lastly MRI data using a customized VGG19 (19 layered Visual Geometric Group) model. Besides that, the synthetic data augmentation idea is adopted to enhance the amount of data accessible for classifier training to improve classification accuracy. The outcomes support the efficacy of the suggested strategy and demonstrate that it is more accurate than already available methodologies.

articleTitle: Bacterial Foraging Particle Swarm Optimization based Wheeling Pricing Allocation through AF-mile and RF-mile approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The research and control of wholesale pricing across each generator and consumer is one of the most important and difficult tasks in the deregulated electricity market. Wheeling price management involves calculating, lowering fees, and allocating benefits between users (generators and consumers) and the owner of transmission. Flow of power control and benefit dividing amongst all trading partners may be modified as the best strategy to manage wheeling prices and generate money. Because of efficient utilization and the fact that users are responsible for paying reverse-flow charges, the majority of owner of transmissions chose an absolute method for pricing computation. However, if the flow of powers are optimized throughout the process and the advantages of the reverse flow are shared by the owner of transmission and users using the benefit dividing factor determined by the governing body, then all trading parties can benefit. Wheeling pricing analysis is a challenging combinational optimization issue that involves nonlinear functions with several local minima and nonlinear discontinuity restrictions. The total price of transmission in flow of power-based approaches depends on flow of power. Here, the management of wheeling prices is described using an optimum flow of power problem with nonlinear constraints. In this study, population-based methods for particle swarm optimization (PSO) and bacterial foraging particle swarm optimization (BF-PSO) were used to examine wheeling pricing, compute reverse flow charges, and optimize power. In this paper wheeling prices analyzed and managed to calculate reverse flow charges and power optimization using particle swarm optimization and BF-PSO which are population based algorithms. On an IEEE-30 bus system, PSO and BF-PSO have been shown to be effective.

articleTitle: An Event-Driven Spectrum-Aware Routing Protocol Based on Hungarian Algorithm in Cognitive Radio Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: An event-driven spectrum-aware routing algorithm based on the Hungarian algorithm (ESRH) is proposed to improve the spectrum utilization and the energy efficiency of cognitive radio sensor networks(CRSN). The method performs clustering in a distributed and self-organized manner and selects the node with the largest weight as the cluster head (CH). The Hungarian algorithm is used to assign the channels with smaller occupancy probability of primary user (PU), longer idle time and higher throughput to sensor nodes (SUs), which reduces the channel competition from SUs to PUs and improves the data transmission success rate. The gateway nodes and packet forwarding nodes are used for relay communication between clusters. Simulation results show that ESRH outperforms ESAC and ERP algorithms in terms of transmission performance, routing stability and network lifetime in a multi-round event-driven CRSN.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of the Pix2pixHD Model for the Improvement of the Fairly Substantial Quality of Low-Light Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In image synthesis, conditional generative adversarial networks (cGANs) have been investigated numerous times and are used for diverse image generation applications. In this work, the domain of low-light image enhancement that involves transforming low-light images into realistic, bright images employing a cGAN is explored. The pix2pixHD model, a cGAN, has been tested, examined, and improved qualitatively and quantitatively for low-light image enhancement. The employed quantitative metrics include both a no-reference Image Quality Assessment (NIQA) metric such as entropy and full-reference IQA (FIQA) metrics such as MSE, PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS. Additionally, the pix2pixHD model with different combinations of loss functions is being investigated. Furthermore, the efficacy of histogram-equalized versions of input images in generating well-illuminated images is investigated by employing the lighter pix2pixHD model. The qualitative and quantitative simulation results are also compared with state-of-the-art deep learning models, and this analysis showed that pix2pixHD can challenge the most recent deep learning models for low-light image enhancement, namely MIRNet, LLFlow, and MIRNetv2, with a minimum inference time of approximately 0. 01s on GPU.

articleTitle: A review on Brain Tumor Detection using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence has in the last 10 years drastically transformed the globe. Owing to its ability to manage vast volumes of data, deep Learning (DL) a subsection of Artificial Intelligence and machine learning, especially in the healthcare area, has proven exceptional accomplishments. New developments in DL based techniques such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs), Generative adversarial neural networks, and many more that have shown exceptional potential for inaccurate categorization of brain cancers. The major goal of this paper is mainly to critically examine the previous identification and classification efforts of brain tumors using MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) data. In this work, we review the best current algorithms for deep learning applications in Brain tumor classification problem contexts and utilization. The most significant findings that have been documented thus far are addressed, and finally, the research’s present hurdles are also highlighted. The conclusion discusses the pros and limitations of deep neural networks. In the time ahead using the results reported in this paper, researchers will be able to evaluate recent studies extensively and gain a knowledge of how different DL algorithms function.

articleTitle: Enhanced VANET Performance by Stable Cluster Head Selection Using Novel Stack of Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The use of VANET turns the roadway into a communal space, enhancing safety and facilitating data sharing among drivers. Data from each automobile is transmitted to the cluster head (CH) via a cluster. There are two main aspects that impact the effectiveness of a VANET network: the optimal number of the vehicle groups and the choice of the control node for stability. In this paper, we model the VANET as a hypergraph network and construct a state-of the-art modularity-based hypergraph clustering formulation by maximising tensor traces and using the modularity matrix as a feed to determine the optimal number of clusters. Automobiles were selected from each group based on how fast they were compared to others in the group, how trustworthy they were deemed by the group as a whole, how long their links lasted, and how well connected they were. All parameters are first transformed to eigenvalues, then a single CH is chosen. By adopting a fuzzy decision-making technique based on three factors, the optimal CH is selected for all vehicles in that cluster. Furthermore, the proposed method for selecting the reliable CH to improve throughput has been validated and significantly improved by comparing it to the other existing techniques.

articleTitle: Predicting The Recurrence of Colorectal Cancer in Patients Using Ensemble Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Among the top ten death-causing diseases in the world, cancer isconsidered to be one. There are about 100 different forms of cancer, and cancer prediction is critical to the advancement of data mining applications. The development of adequate methods for locating cancer instances will go a long way toward improving cancer patient therapy diagnosis. The term “cancer” refers to a group of disorders. All malignancies are caused by cells that continue to divide without stopping and spread to surrounding tissues. The ensemble model can be effectively used to prognosticate the recurrence of colorectal cancer in clinical patients. According to current data from Globacan India, over 27,000 cases were documented in the preceding year, with about 20,000 people dying. In this project, ensemble approaches are utilized to predict cancer recurrence. Basic classifier approaches such as SVM, and RF, as wellf as ensemble classifiers of bagging, were employed to construct classier models. According to the findings, the constructed models’ prediction performance was normally good. In terms of accuracy, ensemble models outperform when compared to Simple classifiers. In a model comparison, the ensemble voting technique outperformed all other models by a significant margin.

articleTitle: Adaptive Multi-Hop Deep Learning based Drug Recommendation System with Selective Coverage Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The goal of drug recommendation is to generate drug prescriptions based on patient’s electronic medical records and provide clinical decision support for doctors. Extracting temporal patterns and contextual information in electronic medical records is the key to successful drug recommendation. However, previous studies have ignored the relationship between patients. As a result, there are differences in the data volume of medical records among different patients, and it is impossible to adjust the focus of attention and the number of data reading iterations in the data reading process according to the individual conditions of different patients. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a selective coverage mechanism and adaptive memory neural network, The drug recommendation model combined with reading. The model uses the neural memory network to store the temporal pattern encoding results corresponding to the patient’s health status and uses the coverage mechanism to perform data filtering and attention weight adjustment in the iterative reading process. At the same time, the model is based on the patient’s situation, Adaptively determining the number of readings of the neural memory network. Experimental results based on accurate clinical data show that this model can adaptively extract essential data from electronic medical records, construct an effective representation vector of the patient’s health status, and then complete drug recommendations.

articleTitle: AI-Enable Generating Human Faces using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Lately, sensible Image processing using deep neural networks has become a fervently discussed issue in machine learning and computer vision. Image can be made at the pixel level by learning from a gigantic variety of pictures. Learning to make splendid movement pictures from highdifference draws is not only a captivating investigation issue yet also a reasonable application in innovative delight. In this research, we research the sketch-to-picture mix issue by using prohibitive generative poorly arranged networks. The model can normally deliver reasonable shadings for a sketch. The new model is not only prepared for painting hand-drawn sketches with real tones, yet also allows customers to exhibit supported tones. Test results on two sketch datasets show that the autopainter performs better contrasted with existing picture-topicture methodologies. With creating interest in the development of film, the interest in building a computerized structure to change over the authentic video into action is higher than at some other time. The edge-by-diagram modification of the action age measure is costly and dreary. To help with moving quickly and with no issue in a robotized collaboration we proposed a generative model that changes over genuine pictures into contrasting energy pictures without losing critical nuances of the source picture. We used an assortment of the generative hostile association as a fundamental plan with the custom incident ability to ensure the substance of the source picture, which changed over to an exuberance image.

articleTitle: A Review of Power Equipment Defect Detection Based On Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The defect of power equipment will lead to the failure of power system, which will cause serious economic loss and social harm. Power equipment defect detection is an important work to ensure the stable operation of power system. In recent years, power equipment defect detection based on deep learning has made remarkable progress. This paper discusses the selection and application of deep learning algorithm in the field of power equipment defect detection, reviews the existed research, and analyzes the research background and significance of power equipment defects. This paper introduces the application of CNN, RNN, GAN and DBN algorithm models in the field of abnormal temperature, pressure and current detection of power equipment. The problems and challenges of algorithm performance, interpretability and test criteria are discussed, and the development prospects in the field of power equipment defect detection are summarized and prospected.

articleTitle: Multi Order Deep Learning Model for Community Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Mining the community structure inside the attribute network allows for analysing additional network nodes with much practical use. The structural information of the attribute network may be successfully included in the graph convolutional neural network, which also generates the node’s feature representation. This enables the community structure to be successfully implemented. However, most graph convolution algorithms now use fixed low-order graph convolution. This method ignores the variety of network architectures and only analyses neighbours in each node’s first or second order. It also does not make full use of the node connection. Furthermore, there is no way to avoid the initial network topology’s sparsity, which makes community discovery less effective. It is hypothesised that a K-order graph convolution community detection technique (KGCN) that incorporates attribute and structural information would overcome the issues above. This strategy, which exploits the nodes’ high-order structure to locate communities, successfully overcomes the original network’s sparsity. To lessen the sparsity of the actual network topology, the current network is redesigned first, utilising the node attribute information. The nodes are then encoded using the K-order graph convolutional encoder to generate their feature representation. Finally, spectral clustering is utilised to identify the network’s communities. The trial fimdings reveal that, when applied to four distinct real-world datasets, the KGCN technique outperforms other algorithms in community discovery.

articleTitle: A Non-Interactive Key-Evolving Protocol to Provide the Intrusion Resilience
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Key-evolving techniques defend from secret key exposures and allow to extend the basic properties of cryptographic schemes by updating the keys time after time. The intrusion resilience is an example of properties that can be achieved by the use of this concept. Intrusion-resilient cryptosystems imply the presence of a sequence of keys for different time periods and allow to provide the security of unexposed secret keys even if a subset of secret keys of that sequence is compromised. In this paper, we propose a generic construction over underlying key exchange and digital signature schemes that allows to achieve the security level comparable to intrusion-resilient cryptosystems. The proposed key-evolving protocol is intended to use in systems, where a direct interactive channel between users can be absent and the frequency of message exchange is relatively small (for example, like in e-mail applications), so it is not possible to apply usual interactive methods providing the intrusion resilience. The protocol described in this paper allows to provide an adequate security level in terms of key evolving in systems with limited possibilities to perform interactive cryptographic protocols.

articleTitle: An Efficient Machine Learning Classification Model for Diabetes Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Chronic diseases include diabetes is one of the deadliest diseases that still poses a severe world-wide health threat because it has an impact on everyone’s health. It’s a genetic condition. that results in excess glucose levels and a number of other issues, including stroke, renal failure, heart and nerve issues, as well as high glucose levels. Numerous researchers have worked to develop a reliable diabetes prediction model throughout the years. Because there are still many unanswered research questions in this field and there aren’t enough reliable data sets and forecasting tools, researchers are turning to deep learning and ML-based approaches. Three different ML algorithms are used in the study to explore issues as it looks at healthcare predictive analytic. The primary purpose of this study was to look at the possible uses of deep learning and machine learning techniques for diabetes therapy. The outcomes indicate the possibility of a high level of accuracy for the machine learning-based architecture. Stakeholders and healthcare professionals are creating categorization models to help with diabetes diagnosis and the creation of prevention strategies. Based on their results, they conduct a literature review of machine model research and offer a unique paradigm for diabetes prediction. Before developing and putting to the test an intellectual ML-based architecture for mellitus forecasting, the researchers conduct a critical analysis of machine learning models. When compared to various basic classifiers for diabetes prediction, such as the DT, SVM, and EDPA (Ensemble Diabetic Prediction Algorithm) ML approaches, the suggested classifier outperformed when compared with the other 2 ML algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Recognition System of Power Grid Non-Intelligent Meter Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This paper makes a detailed study and analysis of the operation mechanism and system application of the intelligent meter recognition system. From three aspects of improving the success rate of acquisition, improving the success rate of cost control implementation and improving the quality of data acquisition, it finds out the constraints in the whole process of operation and maintenance, and puts forward and implements a series of optimization measures. After implementation, the stability and success rate of data acquisition have been further improved, the success rate of remote cost control has been significantly improved, and the quality management of data acquisition has been improved, which has laid a foundation for the operation and maintenance research to improve the company’s marketing and production automation level. For the sampling operation mechanism, the fault monitoring and sending single mechanism is an important link. The research has identified the specific advantages of the new fault monitoring and sending single mechanism in five aspects: exception monitoring and analysis, closed-loop management process, operation knowledge base, on-site application and evaluation indicators, and improved the efficiency of collection and operation.

articleTitle: CT-PET Based Image Fusion Algorithm for Medical Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Medical images are very important in the clinical environment for detection, diagnosis, staging, response assessment, and survival rate prediction. There are many invasive and non-invasive ways to obtain medical images. Each single image acquired will results different image modalities, such as CT, MRI, PET, and SPET, considered in the different diagnosis information pertaining to either structural or functional issues. Image fusion is defined as the process to combine multiple input images of different modalities such as CT, PET, MRI, etc. into one image with the goal of creating single image, that has more description and detailing than the one provided by any of the single images. The fused CT and PET results, better detailing of structural and functional information in a single frame, which in turn helps the doctors for proper diagnosis. Here, we discussed and compared various medical image fusion technics, like Simple averaging, Principal Component Analysis PCA, Fast-Filtering, Guided Image Filter, and Discrete Wavelet Transforms (DWT), for the purpose to fuse CT and PET Images modalities. Finally analyzed the resultant fused image in terms of quantitative and qualitative metrics, for determine the performance of each algorithm. DWT is showing the promising results in terms of both qualitative and quantitative parameters, in terms of Q MI (Normalized Mutual Information)-0.697, QG (Gradient-based fusion performance) -0.529, and QM (Multi-scale Scheme) -0.365). were as simple averaging filter yields lowest and best Q NCIE (Nonlinear correlation information entropy) value- 0.808, and Guided Image Filter method results higher value of the Q CB (ChenBlum Metric) -0.620.

articleTitle: Research on Secure Interactive System of Video Surveillance Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of China’s scientific and technological level in recent years, the monitoring technology has achieved significant development, so it has been widely used in many fields, such as large shopping malls, offices, banks and enterprises. Combined with the actual situation, the effect of the traditional safety monitoring system is relatively poor, and the monitoring is mainly carried out in a human way, resulting in the relevant data interaction ability can not meet the actual needs. In this paper, a new secure interactive system of video surveillance data is designed for the secure interaction of video surveillance data. By using boosting algorithm to process dynamic video images, users can obtain more effective video data. The cleaned video data is shared through the blockchain platform. In the blockchain network, the video is encrypted through the encryption algorithm, and the data is decrypted through the decryption algorithm, so that the video data provides a security level in the sharing process. Experiments show that the sharing rate of video data and the degree of confidentiality of data between different regions are relatively high, which realizes the sharing and encryption of data transmission process and greatly improves the security performance of video surveillance data interaction. Therefore, it is necessary to study and design the interactive ability and data sharing ability of the current video surveillance system.

articleTitle: Suspect Face Detection by Auto Sketching
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In the Modern world, the crime rate has been increasing day by day. To find the suspect face is a completely different task. So, the police want to draw the face sketch by the eye-witness. But it takes a lot of time and so to finish the sketch. Sometimes the face sketches are inaccurate because of the artist’s incorrect drawing and the eye-witness’s incorrect description. The main objective of the proposed work is to create an application using Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) technology to generate unique images of human faces. our program will be generating more realistic images according to the inputs given by the user. This would be possible when the different slides of facial features such as Skin Tone, Facial Hair Length, Shape of the Head, etc are present in the application. These images are fake but it is similar to human faces. Our experimental outcomes are shown that the sketches generated by this application are more accurate and matched than the normal hand-drawn sketches. This application is directly used by the police to sketch persons. These sketches are better than hand draws due to the images created by using this application. It is convenient and more particle to use.

articleTitle: Lung Cancer Classification Using CapsNets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 12th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Convolution Neural Networks being computationally intense, can automatically detect feature maps from the images. Although the performance of CNN is excellent, there is a loss of valuable information when using pooling layers. The concept of CapsNets, which overcomes the loss of information during pooling operations, is promising in deep learning. The system provides subpar results on benchmark data sets that have complex setups. Congruent with the excellent results achieved by Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), namely DeepCaps, an architecture based on convolutional 3D models and a dynamic routing process. With Deep Caps, we significantly exceed the current state of the art in the CapsNets on LuNa-16, while achieving a significant percentage decrease in parameter count. In addition, we present a decoder network (independent of class) that enables us to apply loss reconstruction as a regularization term. Thus, we come to another fascinating attribute of the decoder, allowing us to manipulate the image’s physical representation determined by its instantiation parameters.
